string.text:
Order a sofa from Shustry. It is much more comfortable for resting after a raid than a sleeping bag on bare concrete. 
 
Bonuses: 
Grants +1% stamina for 5 hours after sleep. Travel time between locations counts.

Repairing the engine and suspension of an old APC makes it possible to use it for a relatively safe, fast trip to the raid site. 
 
Bonuses: 
Reduces travel time to the location. 
Raid duration with APC: +10 minutes. 
APC fuel: one canister or a cash payment. 
Can be combined with a helicopter.

Hire Sancho as a butcher courier. He can properly process mutant trophies so they fetch a better price from scientists. 
 
Bonuses: 
Adds a butcher courier. 
Buys mutant parts at a higher price. 
Sells a wide range of food, drinks, and MREs at a fair price.

A specialized electronic device based on Professor Sakharov prototype. New parametric sensors and Professor German adaptive algorithm estimate the interval between Super-Emissions more accurately, saving precious raid minutes. 
 
Bonuses: 
Raid duration: +5 minutes permanently.
Works even in special raids such as Sorties.
Already fueled for the next raid.
Order an APC trip for the next raid \n %s rubles or 1 fuel canister
Order helicopter deployment for the next raid \n %s rubles or 1 fuel canister

Buying a radio and paying the right people lets you call in a helicopter for deployment. This saves travel time and extends the interval between emissions for the raid. 
 
Bonuses: 
Travel time to the location is greatly reduced. 
Raid duration with helicopter: +20 minutes. 
Helicopter fuel: one fuel canister or a cash payment. 
Can be combined with the APC.

Hire the mechanic assistant Motych. He can supply spare parts, upgrades, and repair kits at a fair price. 
 
Bonuses: 
Adds a mechanic trader who can quickly repair equipment. 
Motychs stock depends on the tools found and includes repair kits and some resources. 
Adds a quest line to find tools for the workbench.

Hire Raven as a medical assistant. He supplies medicine and provides medical care for a small fee. Thanks to his connections in the Zone, Raven can also trade certain rare or unique items. 
 
Bonuses: 
Adds a medical trader. 
30% discount on medical goods. 
Medical care for a fair price. 
Can exchange various items.

Install an Anomalous Extractor Resonator, or AER unit for short. This unique device became possible after the Dusk super-anomaly appeared and was developed by Professor Rozhkov, Sakharov and German best student. The calibration documentation for the prototype was lost somewhere in the Zone, so restoring it will not be easy... 
 
Bonuses: 
The AER unit can split artifacts into A-Fractions matching the artifact nature.
A-Fractions can be used to improve any artifact or generate a new sample.
The unit includes an artifact encyclopedia that stores the properties of every discovered sample in a database.

Buy a workbench to repair and upgrade equipment. 
 
Bonuses: 
Provides personal access to a workbench for repairing any equipment.
Unlocks the mechanic stalker Motych for hire.
